title: How much usable structural data is there per receptor?
message: Very uneven: ERα and PPARγ hold 40% of all 1,805 z-scored entries.

title: Which receptors support an APO vs HOLO comparison?
message: Only 19 receptors have both APO and HOLO entries, and 10 of them are ≥ 80% HOLO.

title: Ligand diversity is very uneven
message: Structure count and ligand diversity are related, but they are not the same thing.

title: Are structures mostly standalone or partner-bound?
message: Some receptor datasets are almost always partner-bound; others are entirely standalone.

title: Between-PDB flexibility heterogeneity differs by receptor
message: Median IQR(z) of each canonical position across PDB entries, highest to lowest.

title: What do these variables tell us together?
message: Dataset size, ligand diversity and partner context do not map simply onto between-PDB heterogeneity.
